{{Nickname}}
A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who used the pseudonym "'''KesselRunner'''" was based on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and had a great deal of experience with [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], KesselRunner commented on the [[TTS-15 Series Tutorial Droid]] entry, passing on a rumor that [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] were developing a version for sale rather than the current version which operated under a leasing model.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], KesselRunner replied to [[Andor Javin]]'s claim that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] did not officially use [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] droids. KesselRunner refuted Javin's assertion, related a personal experience where Imperial officials sanctioned the use of an IT-O to interrogate them before shipping the smuggler to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="CDD14">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], KesselRunner commented on the entry for the [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid]], noting that individuals could make a lot of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] selling the units to wealthy families. The trick was finding a source to buy them from that wouldn't cost a lot of money.<ref name="CDD13">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref> KesselRunner later left a note on the entry for the [[RM-2020 espionage droid]], passing on information that [[Churhee's Riflemen]] were in the market for the droids. Several months later, KesselRunner warned his fellow smugglers from conducting illegal activities around [[IN-4 information droid]]s. Since the droids were being regularly used for espionage by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], the droids were often under surveillance by [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[C4LR litigation droid]], KesselRunner wondered if the droid's mermory capacity could be adapted to other systems, such using their [[Droid brain/Legends|brains]] to upgrade [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] and damage control systems.<ref name="CFTD" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], KesselRunner commented on the entry for the [[V6-series pilot droid]] stating that they could not imagine letting a droid pilot their ship. While KesselRunner did see use for them in moving cargo over short distances, or moving ships in parking orbits, the smuggler was incredulous that both the Empire and the Alliance continued to use the droids in the middle of a [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]].<ref name="CFTD" />
